summary: Iteration 8: Verified period-comparison analytics on /api/insights and /api/charts plus the new TrendArrow / Compare toggle UI on Dashboard and Charts pages. Backend pytest: 8 passed, 1 skipped (math test skipped because previous 14-day window has no seeded data). Frontend Playwright: Dashboard insights show trend arrows (Heart Rate +0.4% red rising, Weight -1.8% green falling) with Latest/Avg/Prev/min-max fields. Your Vitals sidebar shows inline TrendArrow next to today's value. Charts page renders vital selector, all 4 date-range buttons (7/14/30/90), Compare toggle, TrendIndicator (Falling ↓), and 4 CompareStatBoxes with Prev values + colored % change pills. Compare toggle adds Previous Period dashed line to chart legend.

issues: Y-axis 'Normal Min' / 'Normal Max' ReferenceLine label is clipped at the chart's left edge (shows as 'lormal Min'). Consider position='insideLeft' with x-offset or smaller font.
When previous period has zero entries, AVG/MIN/MAX stat cards hide the 'Prev:' line (correct), but READINGS shows 'Prev: 0' which is inconsistent. Consider hiding Prev when previous count is 0.

passed_tests: GET /api/insights returns trend, change_percent, previous_average, min, max, entry_count for each vital
GET /api/insights weight & heart_rate have non-null previous_average and change_percent (14-day seed)
GET /api/charts/weight?start_date=..&end_date=.. returns stats, previous_stats, change_percent, trend
GET /api/charts/weight?compare=true returns previous_entries array (omitted when compare=false)
UI Dashboard: Health Insights list shows TrendArrow with %, Status dot, Latest/Avg/Prev/min-max/readings
UI Dashboard: Your Vitals sidebar shows TrendArrow inline with today's value (heart_rate 85 bpm ↑0.4%, weight 68.8 kg ↓1.8%)
UI Charts: vital selector, date-range buttons (7/14/30/90), Compare toggle, TrendIndicator all render with data-testid
UI Charts: toggling Compare changes Recharts legend from 'Current' to 'Current, Previous Period' (overlay line appears)
UI Charts: switching to 7-day range refreshes stat cards (AVG 72 kg, Prev 70.7, 1.8% pill; MAX 74.5 Prev 74.8 0.4%; Readings 8 Prev 6 33.3%)
action_items: Optional: reposition Recharts ReferenceLine labels so 'Normal Min/Max' text isn't clipped on the left edge.
Optional: in CompareStatBox, suppress 'Prev: 0' on count-style stats (Readings) when previous count == 0 for visual consistency with AVG/MIN/MAX.
critical_code_review_comments: Charts.js line 100-109: previous-period overlay aligns prev entries by *index* into current entries, not by date offset. If either period has missing days, the overlay is misaligned. Consider mapping by day-offset from start_date.

vitals.py _compute_stats: returns avg=None when list empty, but change_percent guard at line 132 uses `prev_stats['avg']` truthiness — if avg==0 this would incorrectly be treated as missing. Use explicit `is not None` check.

vitals.py get_chart_data trend computation uses only last 3 values (vals[-3:]) — for a 90-day range this is a very narrow trend window. Consider linear regression or first-vs-last-quarter comparison for longer ranges.

Dashboard.js TrendArrow: 'rising' is always shown as red and 'falling' as green. For some vitals (e.g., physical_activity, hydration_level, sleep_duration) rising is *good*. Consider a per-vital direction-good map to color trends correctly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 executed, 1 skipped due to seed data window)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (14 days of weight 68-75 kg & heart_rate 65-90 bpm for admin1). No new seeding required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-8 features (TrendArrow, period-comparison stats, Compare toggle, previous_entries overlay) are functional end-to-end. Backend /api/insights and /api/charts/{vital_key} return the new fields. UI renders trend arrows colored correctly (rising=red, falling=green). Two design refinements + four code-review notes flagged for E1's discretion. Key data-testid: insight-{vital_key}, vital-card-{vital_key}, chart-vital-select, chart-range-{7|14|30|90}, compare-toggle, stat-{average|minimum|maximum|readings}, charts-page, user-dashboard.
